lines.text: Okay, thanks everyone for jumping on. This is the launch sync.
Great. So first thing, we are not going to make Wednesday. I think we should move the launch to Friday.
Friday works. That gives us two more days for QA on the checkout flow.
On pricing, Marco is going to own the pricing page. He has the new tiers and the annual discount.
One risk. Refunds are still manual. We need Stripe webhooks wired up before we open the doors.
Agreed. Let's make the webhook work the top engineering priority this week.
And the onboarding emails are drafted, they just need a final pass.
What about the pricing page copy? Is that blocked on legal?
Not blocked. Legal only needs to see the refund language, nothing else on the page.
I can have the tiers laid out by Wednesday morning so there is time to react.
Good. Let's also decide who is on call over the weekend after we ship.
I'll take Saturday. Marco, can you cover Sunday if anything comes through?
Sunday works. I'll watch the refund queue and the webhook logs.
One more thing. Do we announce on the mailing list the same day, or wait?
Same day. Sending it later just splits the traffic across two days.
Quick follow up. Who actually signs off on the launch copy?
Let's say I have final sign off on copy, and legal reviews the refund language.
Perfect. I will send a recap and a Loom walkthrough by Monday.
